device.description: 16-bit 1 MSPS dual simultaneous-sampling SAR ADC with internal references, SPI with register map
device.note: ads8355.pdf (SBAS761A) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.8 timing requirements, p.9 switching characteristics and Figure 1, p.18 Tables 2-3 transfer characteristics, p.19-20 dual/single-SDO data read, p.20-21 low-power modes, p.21-22 Table 4 commands and register read/write, p.23-28 register map

registers.name: PD_STANDBY
registers.note: p.24 Table 7: bits 7-3 and 0 reserved (R); writable only after PD_KEY = 1001b

registers.name: PD_KEY
registers.note: p.24 Table 8: writing 1001b enables writes to PD_STANDBY

registers.name: SDO_CTRL
registers.note: p.25 Table 9: 0 = dual SDO (SDO_A and SDO_B), 1 = single SDO (SDO_A only)

registers.name: DATA_OUT_CTRL
registers.note: p.25 Table 10: 0 = straight binary, 1 = twos complement

registers.name: INPUT_CONFIG
registers.note: p.27-28 Table 16: RANGE_SEL 0 = 0..VREF, 1 = 0..2xVREF; AINM_SEL 0 = single-ended, 1 = pseudo-differential

commands.name: NOP
commands.note: p.21 Table 4: no operation; the next frame gives the conversion result

commands.name: WR_REG (PD_STANDBY locked)
commands.note: p.24: PD_STANDBY is written only after PD_KEY = 1001b

commands.name: WR_REG
commands.note: p.21-22 Table 4, Figure 32: 20-bit frame, right-aligned (the last 20 bits before CS rises), decoded on CS rising

commands.name: RD_REG
commands.note: p.21 Figure 31: the register data are the first 8 bits on SDO_A in the next frame

pages: p.3 (pins), p.5 (ROC: DVDD 1.65-5.5 V), p.8 (timing requirements), p.9 (switching characteristics: tCONV 650 ns, tDEN_CSDO 14.5 ns, tDZ_CSDO 37 ns, tD_CKDO 19.5 ns; Figure 1), p.18 (Tables 2-3 output codes), p.19-20 (Figures 29-30 dual/single-SDO frames), p.20-21 (STANDBY/PD), p.21-22 (Table 4 commands, Figures 31-32), p.23-28 (Tables 5-16 register map)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal reference, REFDACs, input range and single-ended / pseudo-differential selection (stored only); every conversion returns the 0 V single-ended input code: 0000h in straight binary, 8000h in twos complement (Table 3: 0 V single-ended = NFSC), hence codeFormat offset for OP_DATA_FORMAT = 1; in pseudo-differential mode the part reads 7FFFh / 0000h for AINP = AINM

channel B: only SDO_A is modeled; in dual-SDO mode (default) SDO_B carries the ADC_B result and is never driven; in single-SDO mode SDO_A outputs ADC_A then ADC_B (both the 0 V code) and SDO_B is driven low
STANDBY and PD (power-down) modes: PD_STANDBY bits are stored (behind the PD_KEY lock) but conversions continue; power-up delays (10 us, 1-3 ms)
whether the PD_KEY unlock stays set after a PD_STANDBY write is not stated (the model keeps it)
writes to reserved / unlisted addresses are ignored by the model (the datasheet: do not modify)
register read-back frame: only the 8-bit register data (MSB first) is given for the next frame; the model shifts zeros after it
minimum tCONV with CS and SCLK high, cycle time, acquisition time and SCLK limits (24 MHz at DVDD < 2.35 V, 50 MHz above)
timing values: tDZ_CSDO 37 ns is the DVDD 1.65-2.35 V maximum (31 ns above 2.35 V)
variants: Single device datasheet. The ADS8350/ADS7250 (ads8350.pdf) are the earlier 750 kSPS versions with a read-only 32-SCLK frame and no SDI.
